name: US–China / Taiwan
value: Trade truce to 10 Jan; APEC Shenzhen next week
summary: China extended its rare-earth control pause to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov; Trump and Xi expected at APEC in Shenzhen
state: China extended its suspension of new rare-earth export controls to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov, keeping the trade truce in place ahead of APEC in Shenzhen, where Presidents Trump and Xi are expected (The National). Taiwan's participation in APEC remains disputed, with Beijing accused on 9 Nov of undermining its status (New Kerala). No blockade, military clash or severed channel was reported as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Tension over Taiwan affects supply of chips and electronics. Follow FCDO travel advice for China and Taiwan.
rubric_hit: Major controls suspended but disputes active; no blockade or clash

sources.title: The National — China extends pause on rare earth export curbs for two months
New Kerala — China accused of undermining Taiwan's status ahead of APEC summit

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
